# MeshWeave

> AI visibility risk analysis for citation, discovery, and agent trust.

MeshWeave audits how AI systems crawl, understand, and cite websites. It identifies structural weaknesses that limit visibility, citation confidence, generative discovery, and AI agent trust — then delivers a prioritized remediation roadmap.

## Core Capabilities

- AI visibility risk analysis across three lenses: AEO, GEO, AAX
- Citation-readiness diagnostics (can AI quote your content?)
- Generative discovery optimization (does AI recommend you?)
- AI agent experience auditing (can agents navigate and act on your site?)
- Entity consistency and crawl-access auditing
- Prioritized, concrete remediation roadmap

## Three Risk Lenses

- **AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)**: Whether AI can extract clear, trustworthy answers from your content. Failure means your brand is not quoted when buyers ask questions.
- **GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)**: Whether AI systems see sufficient authority, trust, and entity signals. Failure means your brand is overlooked in recommendations.
- **AAX (AI Agent Experience)**: Whether AI agents can understand, navigate, and act on your site. Failure means agent-mediated buyers abandon before conversion.
